none: PAS NLM-9D5827: Roman Coin: Nummus fraction of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian, Securitas Rei Publicae issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath [and palm]. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 17.9mm, Weight: 1.86gms, die axis: 12
